topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Finding the time capsule was like stumbling upon a forgotten memory, a part of my past that I had lost touch with. Each item inside, once so familiar, now feels distant, like looking through an old photo album of a person you once knew well but can no longer recognize. The letters, the small mementos, they all hint at a life once lived with such intensity and purpose. It’s strange how time can make you feel like a stranger to your own history. I keep touching the objects, trying to reconnect, to feel the same zest I once had. It’s as if I’m searching for a part of myself that slipped away without me noticing.
